### 2026-10-24: October 23:

**7h**

October 23:

Ok. I was about to yeet this project out the window for a second here.

So I finished setting everything up. I rewired the whole board, changed the board size, and added some awesome  silkscreens including a cool cover title. It was all looking nice. I looked at it in the 3d viewer, and thought:

![Screenshot 2026-10-23 185750](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/94e658a97f8429fbcea5b3448b5adbee085012e3676525404230ceacc421e79b.png)

This can only go up, right? I mean, it looks beautiful.

Then I exported it as a .step file and tried to view it in 3d in Bambu Studio. And this is what I ended up with.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/b4c6b1352b51d067425bb3b5201c5863e63eb02b966a00d3af09d8af3c2f08c9.png)

In case you're having a hard time seeing it like I was, that tiny little thing in the upper left corner of the selection is the board itself. The rest of it is resistors, capacitors, and diodes in the weirdest sizes you've ever seen.

After a bit of work (aka a lot of research and a lot more trial and error) I finally got it properly sized and put into Fusion!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/dfb928b11ab3527a7beb228e305c4bc670a6fa6e0a422ece1e2cb69e21739e0c.png)

Not as stylish as I might have wanted, but still properly sized. After that debacle, I started designing the case. Here you can see the different thought processes going through my head:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/eca13f8cd2399d93775284c3ef315b17f9ccd45951643b0e35cd28a777d39f9b.png)
*Well this audio amplifier is going to be a pain. How in the world can I get this darn thing properly seated...*

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/7855496ca01ab0416eb9779c03b29a9bef0c32d922950e4ce6a080cc205a82ba.png)
*Ok. Ok. This is looking better. I mean, the top is odd, but... it'll do.*

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/400b1e81db4fee3372363cd82574a5b5aaf392ec64c6e0a4719d45e8e3c12f09.png)
*Awesome. Just gotta make these pins for the board to sit on so it doesn't slip... unlike a past design... but we don't talk about that*

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/s61tPc9A88autrbyrr9fv2hQxkAo5xlf/88fff389aea5d4d2c2db7bd164e9ed96df12352e55d832bf23f3d832aa12e63e.png)
*Ahh... Beautiful. Now I've started adding on some designs, and I...*
